comments.body: `promiseAll` is called here, but this file never imports it. The diff changes `Promise.all` to `promiseAll` at this line and adds no `import { promiseAll } from "@medusajs/utils"`. The file has no import or require of `@medusajs/utils`, and a grep for `promiseAll` in it matches only this call. It is a plain `.js` file, so `tsc` does not catch it. When the order subscriber's discount-usage handler runs, it will throw `ReferenceError: promiseAll is not defined`. Discount `usage_count` will then never be updated after an order is placed. Every other file that uses `promiseAll` imports it.
